summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_control.py, test_console.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, black, and mypy were not run, per instructions; formatting was checked by hand.
